topics.label: Lecture introduction and overview of cancer evolution
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture theme, sets the learning objectives, and outlines the evolutionary framework of cancer development.

topics.label: Genetic and epigenetic mechanisms of clonal selection
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how successive genetic mutations and epigenetic alterations confer selective growth advantages to expanding cellular clones.

topics.label: Cell of origin and stem cell hierarchies in tumorigenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the influence of normal tissue hierarchy and stemness on a cell's susceptibility to malignant transformation.

topics.label: Microenvironmental and inflammatory drivers of tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics investigate how external promotional signals, chronic inflammation, and supportive stroma permit transformed cells to progress into invasive cancers.

topics.label: Experimental methods for investigating tumor evolution and spatial biology
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines modern computational and spatial profiling technologies used to study cancer cell states and cellular interactions.

topics.label: Lecture summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics synthesise the multifactorial model of cancer evolution and conclude the session.
